2608.04190.title: Adversarially Robust Abductive Fusion of Pre-trained Transformer-based Perception Models
2608.04190.paper_summary: Deploying pre-trained perception models in novel environments degrades their accuracy under distributional shift, and assembling them alone does not recover it: combiners such as majority voting trade recall for precision and are brittle to coordinated failures. Prior metacognitive methods learn logical rules that flag a model's errors, but rely on hand-authored domain-knowledge cues (object-size priors, segmentation masks) that do not transfer to genuinely novel scenes. We show that this metacognitive layer can be learned without any domain knowledge by exploiting vector-space geometry: per-model Label Vector Pools (LVP), built from each model's own training embeddings, yield error-detection rules from the geometry of detections relative to training-determined prototypes, reaching parity with domain-knowledge rules to within $0.002$ every F1 on test set. Because the approach remains neurosymbolic, these geometric rules share a single logical framework and can still be complemented by domain knowledge when available. We frame the fusion of multiple imperfect ViT-based detectors as a consistency-based abduction problem solved at test time by an exact Integer Program (IP) and a polynomial-time heuristic. On an aerial-imagery benchmark of 15 weather-shifted test sets and six ViT detectors, our domain-knowledge-free layer matches the strongest majority-vote variant on clean data (within $0.005$ F1) and, unlike every majority-vote baseline, retains its performance under a coordinated label-flipping attack: at a $90\%$ flip rate it averages $0.42$ F1 versus $0.35$ for MV-Plurality (a $22\%$ relative gain) and attains the highest F1 on \emph{every} test set once the flip rate exceeds $0.4$
2608.04190.paper_summary_zh: 在新環境中部署預訓練的感知模型會在分佈變化下降低其準確性，僅僅組合它們並不能恢復準確性：像是多數投票這樣的組合器在精確度上以召回率為代價，並且對協調失敗非常脆弱。先前的元認知方法學習邏輯規則來標記模型的錯誤，但依賴於手工編寫的領域知識提示（物體大小先驗、分割掩碼），這些提示無法轉移到真正的新場景。我們展示了這一元認知層可以在不依賴任何領域知識的情況下通過利用向量空間幾何來學習：每個模型的標籤向量池（LVP），由每個模型自己的訓練嵌入構建，從檢測相對於訓練確定的原型的幾何中產生錯誤檢測規則，達到與領域知識規則的相當，F1在測試集上每次相差不超過 $0.002$。因為這種方法仍然是神經符號的，這些幾何規則共享一個單一的邏輯框架，並且在可用時仍然可以通過領域知識進行補充。我們將多個不完美的基於ViT的檢測器的融合框架化為一個基於一致性的推理問題，通過精確的整數規劃（IP）和多項式時間啟發式在測試時解決。在15個氣候變化測試集和六個ViT檢測器的航空影像基準上，我們的無領域知識層在乾淨數據上匹配最強的多數投票變體（在 $0.005$ F1 之內），並且與每個多數投票基線不同，在協調標籤翻轉攻擊下保持其性能：在 $90\%$ 的翻轉率下，它的平均F1為 $0.42$，而MV-Plurality為 $0.35$（相對增益為 $22\%$），一旦翻轉率超過 $0.4$，在\emph{每個}測試集上達到最高的F1。
